Name: Aarong Dairy Roshogolla 600 gm
LongDescription: Aarong Dairy Roshogolla is a traditional Bengali dessert made from fresh cottage cheese (chhana), offering a sweet and delightful flavor. Packaged in a 600 gm tin, it is perfect for various occasions and celebrations. rnrnIngredients: Whole Milk, Chhana (cottage cheese), Sugar, Wheat, Flour, Vinegar, Cardamom, Potable Water , BADAMI.rnMaking Process:rnPreparation of Chhana:rnBoil whole milk and curdle it using vinegar to separate the curds from the whey.rnStrain the curds through a muslin cloth to obtain chhana.rnKneading:Knead the chhana with a small amount of wheat flour until it becomes smooth and pliable.rnShaping:Divide the kneaded chhana into small, smooth balls.rnCooking in Syrup:Prepare a light sugar syrup infused with cardamom.rnBoil the chhana balls in the syrup until they expand and become spongy.rnSoaking:Allow the cooked roshogollas to soak in the syrup to absorb sweetness.rnUse:rnServing:Serve chilled or at room temperature as a dessert.rnIdeal for festive occasions, family gatherings, or as a sweet treat after meals.rnrnBenefits:rnSource of Protein:Chhana provides a good amount of protein, essential for body functions.rnCalcium-Rich:Made from milk, it offers calcium, beneficial for bone health.rnEnergy Boost:The sugar content provides a quick source of energy.rnrnNet Weight : 600 gm.
